name: Grok Build
description: Terminal-native coding agent from xAI (formerly SpaceXAI) that launched with Grok 4.5 as its default model. Features parallel agent architecture spawning up to eight parallel sub-agents, capable of autonomous planning, file editing, command execution, Excel model building, and Office document generation. The harness is open-source under Apache 2.0 license on GitHub. Competes directly with Claude Code and Codex CLI in the AI coding agent market.
community_quotes: Parallelism over depth architecture with eight parallel sub-agents
Terminal-native coding agent that plans, edits files, and runs commands autonomously
Competes in the three-way race against Claude Code and Codex CLI
Open-sourced under Apache 2.0 license on GitHub
Can assemble Excel models, PowerPoint decks, and Word documents
Grok 4.5 ranked #1 on Harvey's Legal Agent benchmark
